# SnackPortal2 Architecture Summary

**Baseline:** `origin/main @ 88db1a5` after PR #11
**Generated by:** PRD 03 V4-R16 Phase C Handover Status-Doc Reconciliation Execution

## Architecture posture

SnackPortal2 backend is vendor-neutral and physically multi-database ready.

Physical Multi-Database MVP is mandatory, not future-only.

One Request → One Active Tenant → One Database remains absolute.

Control DB is separate from Tenant DBs.

Tenant DB is separate from Tenant DB.

Database Router remains the sole DB selector.

Gateway must not resolve databases directly.

Frontend must not route directly to many databases.

Portal contracts do not perform database routing.

Ownership does not perform database routing.

Authentication does not perform database routing.

## Current contract posture

IC-009 is Final / IC-009-R1.

IC-010 is Final as the API Gateway Contract, but API Gateway implementation has not started.

IC-009-ADOPT is recorded in the Architecture Decision Register.

DEC-11 remains binding.

## DEC-11

The API Gateway must not bind ownership-audit DTO residency until the IC-002 ownership-audit-section extension lands.

This remains a blocker for ownership-audit DTO residency binding.

## Anti-lock-in posture

No Lovable / Supabase coupling is allowed in backend governance.

No direct Supabase/PostgREST business-table access from frontend should be treated as satisfying the final SnackPortal2 backend architecture.

Physical Multi-Database MVP is mandatory.

## Next architecture step

After V4-R17 passes, prepare API Gateway readiness PRD.

Do not start API Gateway implementation until readiness is complete and DEC-11 remains preserved.
